rulings.text: Ruling: Continue with a versioned local numerical branch-envelope diagnostic under the existing approved builder scope — two independent mathematical investigations support a map-preserving remedy for the observed discontinuous stopping failure and the user explicitly requested continuation — if wrong, extra implementation and exploratory rerun cost; old and future evidence remain separately identified and protected execution stays gated.

Ruling: Preserve local scope and ordinary float64 diagnostic status rather than claiming global or exact optimization — the existing approved tuning convention is local and no rigorous arithmetic enclosure is implemented — if wrong, the diagnostic can remain conservative or miss a distant valley under the unchanged local convention, which must remain an explicit limitation.

Ruling: Add bounded primary-pilot retention as Task 3 before scaling the program — complete raw publication followed by compact planning state addresses cumulative graph retention without weakening evidence or reserves — if wrong, resource planning may be understated or statistics changed; parity, full-payload envelope and lifecycle regressions plus independent review are required before fresh G6.

Ruling: Recover the interrupted unchanged cohort in a fresh output with a parent launcher that waits directly for the CLI — optional monitor failure terminated the first capture, so an actual completed command and comparison are still required — if wrong, up to one repeated developmental cohort's compute/storage is spent; all partial evidence stays retained and independent-new-preparations remains0.

Ruling: Export complete benchmark raw workers through versioned hash-bound references and stream paired technical replay — cohort-sized duplicate ledgers/projections are avoidable while all scientific fields and comparisons can be preserved — if wrong, report consumers need migration or evidence/comparison integrity could regress; explicit schema version, complete semantic parity, hash/alias/gate/lifecycle tests and scoped review are required, with existing resource reserves unchanged.

Ruling: Declare each replay input's existing executions/input_id directory as an explicit versioned reference package base — this preserves existing remeasured-worker placement while making worker/index/stdout paths portable and unambiguous — if wrong, consumers can resolve links against the wrong root; moved-package/reference tests and explicit base metadata are required, with full worker semantics unchanged.
